groundColour: Warm and brown earth with irregular clear-soil patches; green terrain removed.

districts.name: Your camp
districts.ground: Existing warm camp earth and stone paths.
districts.purpose: The fixed home base. Keep all placed buildings, walls, foliage and camp exits in place.

districts.name: Overgrown village
districts.ground: Deeper woodland brown, muted grass and small pockets of old paving.
districts.purpose: A substantial exploration district with streets, enterable buildings, courtyards and wooded gaps. Approach from camp and the eastern village trail.

districts.name: Factory & rail yard
districts.ground: Cool brown earth, grey gravel and worn service paving.
districts.purpose: Large industrial buildings and outdoor yards. Existing eastern paths become the southern approaches; reserve space for the railway on the far east.

districts.name: Scrap warehouse
districts.ground: Brown dirt yards, muted rust-coloured fines and patches of encroaching grass.
districts.purpose: A full warehouse district with salvage yards and room to explore around the buildings. Separate from the small storage building near camp.

districts.name: Waterworks
districts.ground: Darker damp soil, brown-grey silt and gravel around structures.
districts.purpose: Treatment buildings, tanks, channels and future bridge assets. Keep the river course and crossings clear before placing terrain or buildings.

districts.name: Logging ground
districts.ground: Deep woodland browns, worn dirt hauling tracks and sparse leaf litter.
districts.purpose: Forest clearings and logging structures across the river, reached by two different approaches. Trees and harvestable resources remain separate assets.

districts.name: Southern meadows
districts.ground: Open olive grass, plain brown earth and a few darker damp hollows.
districts.purpose: Room to roam, hunt and gather away from roads. Small future points of interest can sit off the main trail without adding a road grid.

batches.name: Southwest camp corner
batches.goal: Continuous ground is complete. The southwest dirt trail will be a separate road overlay.

batches.name: West camp, lower ground
batches.goal: Continuous ground wraps the southwest corner. Route overlays and scenery remain to be placed.

batches.name: West camp, middle ground
batches.goal: Continuous ground reaches the western district areas. The trail and river crossing remain planned.

batches.name: West camp, upper woodland
batches.goal: Broad road-free brown earth connects above the western exit, ready for separately placed foliage.

batches.name: Northwest camp connection
batches.goal: Northwest ground is complete. Add the logging approach as a separate overlay later.

batches.name: North camp connection
batches.goal: Northern ground is complete. Both village approaches remain planned road overlays.

phases.name: Ground foundation — complete
phases.detail: The entire 20,000 × 20,000 terrain-pixel world is covered. The original camp stays fixed; surrounding ground uses large overlapping camp-style images with gradual colour blends.

phases.name: River and western districts
phases.detail: Fix bank shapes and all crossing approaches before painting water. Build west towards logging and southwest towards waterworks, with two return routes.

phases.name: Northern village
phases.detail: Connect both northern approaches, then build the district footprint and the woodland link back to the logging crossing.

phases.name: Factory and scrap districts
phases.detail: Add separate eastern road overlays into the northern factory and southern scrap warehouse. Reserve the railway and building footprints first.

phases.name: Southern meadows
phases.detail: Extend the southern trail, build the meadow crossings, and close the waterworks–meadow–scrap loop with substantial off-road ground.

phases.name: Dress and test the world
phases.detail: Add separate foliage, buildings, resources and encounters; check movement, sightlines, return journeys and phone performance district by district.
